states.name: ussr-plays-us-cards
states.description: Turn 4, AR 1, the USSR to act holding three US cards (Duck and Cover — DEFCON -1 and a VP swing for the US; Our Man in Tehran, whose event isn't implemented; Camp David Accords) and its own Fidel. Playing a US card for operations also triggers its event, in either order; Fidel (its own) and a space attempt do not.

states.name: us-plays-blocked-ussr-card
states.description: The US to act holding Arab-Israeli War, a USSR card, with Camp David Accords already in the removed pile — which prevents it. Spent for operations the event simply doesn't happen.

states.name: ussr-plays-us-card-at-defcon-2
states.description: DEFCON 2 and the USSR to act holding Duck and Cover (a US card, DEFCON -1): its event takes DEFCON to 1, which loses the game for the phasing USSR — whichever half is played first.
